description: One monthly batch of upgrade PRs for npm packages and GitHub Actions.
Each npm PR changes one package, as docs/versions.md asks; tooling/versions fails until the PR also updates that package's row there.
Actions stay pinned to a commit SHA with the tag in a comment. AF owns its pins (ADR 0006): no other project's list holds them back.

packageRules.description: These move with their partner, never alone: the vitest browser provider (same major as vitest) and the Playwright image (same tag as playwright).
GSAP stays on 3.x: 4.x is a new major under licence terms nobody on the team has read, and any version released after a licence change comes under the new terms.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, re-read https://gsap.com/standard-license: its last modified date was 2025-05-30 when 3.15.0 was chosen. The site uses it free; it must stay free for the paid apps.

packageRules.description: Every GitHub Actions upgrade in one PR, pinned to its commit.
